title: Coding Set 11: Matrix Multiplication & Zero-Sum Subarray
description: Matrix product validation and prefix-sum hashing to find the longest contiguous subarray summing to zero.

problems.title: Matrix Multiplication with Dimension Validation
problems.statement: Given matrix A of dimensions R1 x C1 and matrix B of dimensions R2 x C2, check if A x B is defined (C1 == R2). If incompatible, print 'INVALID'. Otherwise, compute and print the resulting R1 x C2 matrix row by row (space-separated integers).
problems.inputFormat:
Line 1: R1 C1 followed by R1 lines of C1 integers for A.
Next line: R2 C2 followed by R2 lines of C2 integers for B.
problems.outputFormat: 'INVALID' or R1 lines each containing C2 space-separated integers.

problems.timeComplexity: O(R1 * C2 * C1) triple nested loop.
edgeCases: Outer product (N x 1) * (1 x M) produces N x M matrix

problems.title: Longest Contiguous Subarray with Zero Sum
problems.statement: Given an integer array A of length N (containing positive, negative, and zero elements), find the length of the longest contiguous subarray whose elements sum to 0. If no such subarray exists, print 0.
problems.inputFormat:
Line 1: Integer N.
Line 2: N space-separated integers.
problems.outputFormat: A single integer denoting the maximum subarray length with sum 0.
